description:
FILED s526w1 (Opus, 2026-10-24) from the URI-5.34 board census (t/escape.t's *PLAN* row: ran 28 of no plan, rc 255).

PCL's Test::Builder has no `parent` method and no `expected_tests` method.  Test::Warnings (CPAN, used by URI's escape.t, and by many modern dists) calls `$builder->parent` in its warning handler / had_no_warnings and `Test::Builder->new->expected_tests` in its END block:
    Can't locate object method "parent" via package "Test::Builder"
    Error in END block: Can't locate object method "expected_tests" via package "Test::Builder"
so the file dies before done_testing and the END block cannot add its "no (unexpected) warnings" row.

REPRO:
    use Test::More; use Test::Warnings; ok(1); done_testing;
  perl 5.40.3: ok 1 / ok 2 - no (unexpected) warnings (via done_testing) / 1..2
  PCL: dies at the first Test::Builder method Test::Warnings needs.

Layer: the TAP layer (cl/pcl-test.lisp / its Test::Builder face): `parent` answers undef outside a subtest (the builder of the enclosing subtest inside one), `expected_tests` the declared plan (0 = none).  docs/tap-assertion-audit.md first.

=== DONE (s539a) ===
PCL's Test::Builder answers parent (undef: PCL never hands out a child builder), expected_tests (the plan, 0 for none; the setter plans), level ($Test::Builder::Level, 1 at load), in_todo, todo, summary, no_plan, BAIL_OUT / BAILOUT, explain, is_eq / isnt_eq / is_num / isnt_num, like / unlike, subtest (cl/pcl-test.lisp; commit "s539a WIP: Test::Builder parent / expected_tests ..."); + `undef *{"main::done_testing"}` (Test::Warnings' import) now shadows main's name instead of unbinding the :pcl TAP function program-wide (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp %p-glob-clear-code-slot).  The task's reproducer prints perl's three lines.  Census vs perl 1.302199: 17 -> 36 public methods (docs/tap-assertion-audit.md "The Test::Builder methods"); the rest need new state = #4886.
Guards: Pl/t/tap-assert-01.t rows 40 42 43, Pl/t/glob-undef-01.t row 12 (all fail on the base 24988e35).
BOARD (one-file, scratch/s539a/legs/board1.log): URI escape.t 26/2 no plan rc 255 -> 27/2 of 29 rc 2 (perl 29); the *PLAN* row LEFT baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv BY EDIT; rows 19 (NS:ns-error-text) and 21 (#221) stay.  Test-Warnings' own t/: 02 03 04 07 09 25 now = perl (base not); 01 21 stop on Test::Tester ctx, 12 on Carp location, 14 propagate-by-subname, 22 warnings->import, 23 24 a Test::Tester run_tests type error (scratch/s539a/tws.txt).
CLOSE-WITH-ROWS: no board row is keyed #3823 any more.
